Policies and Initiatives.title: Goa proposes curbs on social media for minors under 16; draft to be sent to Centre
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Goa's IT Minister has proposed nationwide restrictions on social media access for minors under 16, citing concerns over detrimental effects on students. The state will submit the proposal to the Union IT Minister for consideration. Additionally, Goa is seeking public feedback on its draft AI policy to promote AI skilling and leverage local talent.

Policies and Initiatives.title: AI-system to challan vehicles sans valid docus at Goa border checkposts
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The GoVA system uses AI-enabled cameras at Goa's border entry points to monitor vehicles. These cameras can identify vehicles without valid documents, enabling authorities to issue challans. The system aims to improve enforcement and compliance at border checkposts.

Major AI Developments.title: AI traffic cameras begin issuing challans at 26 locations across Goa
Major AI Developments.summary: AI traffic cameras have started issuing challans at 26 locations across Goa. The cameras use artificial intelligence to detect traffic violations and automatically generate fines. This initiative aims to improve road safety and enforce traffic rules in the state.

Major AI Developments.title: NCPOR turns to AI to unlock the secrets hidden in the ocean floor
Major AI Developments.summary: The National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR) is utilizing artificial intelligence (AI) to uncover secrets hidden on the ocean floor. This initiative aims to unlock new knowledge and discoveries about the ocean. NCPOR's use of AI technology is expected to enhance its research capabilities and provide new insights into the ocean's depths.

Major AI Developments.title: 17% dip in accidents, govt credits AI & data analytics
Major AI Developments.summary: The government has reported a 17% decrease in accidents, attributing the decline to the effective use of AI and data analytics. This integration of technology has helped in identifying and mitigating potential accident causes, leading to improved safety outcomes. The government's credit of AI and data analytics highlights their significant role in reducing accidents.

Major AI Developments.title: Goa turns to AI to convert piles of govt paperwork to digital records
Major AI Developments.summary: The Indian state of Goa is utilizing AI technology to digitize large amounts of government paperwork. This initiative aims to convert physical records into digital formats, increasing efficiency and accessibility. The project is part of Goa's efforts to modernize its administrative processes and reduce paper waste.

Major AI Developments.title: Draft AI policy aims to train 50,000 professionals by 2030
Major AI Developments.summary: A draft AI policy aims to train 50,000 professionals by 2030, focusing on developing expertise in artificial intelligence. The policy's goal is to create a skilled workforce in the AI sector, with a target completion date of 2030. The initiative is part of a broader effort to advance AI adoption and development.

Major AI Developments.title: AI policy to train 50k professionals by 2030
Major AI Developments.summary: Goa's new draft AI policy aims to train 50,000 certified AI professionals by 2030 and make AI a compulsory school subject from Class VI. The policy also seeks to attract five global AI companies to the state by 2028. This initiative targets a significant boost in AI talent in the region.

Major AI Developments.title: Goa to deploy AI cams to look inside tinted cars
Major AI Developments.summary: Goa is deploying an AI-powered surveillance system with high-speed detection and night vision to enhance law enforcement and road safety. The system, which includes 92 cameras at strategic locations, can identify individuals and capture license plates. The cameras will be monitored from a command center and rolled out in phases to effectively track offenders.

Major AI Developments.title: AI traffic cameras to have number plate recognition
Major AI Developments.summary: AI-powered traffic cameras are being introduced with number plate recognition capabilities. These cameras will utilize artificial intelligence to identify and record vehicle license plates, enhancing traffic management and enforcement. The technology aims to improve road safety and efficiency by automatically detecting and responding to traffic violations.

Major AI Developments.title: Join AI attendance or face pay cut, says panchayats minister
Major AI Developments.summary: The panchayats minister has announced that employees must join the AI attendance system or face a pay cut. This move aims to track employee attendance and increase accountability. The minister's directive is part of an effort to modernize and streamline attendance tracking using artificial intelligence.

Major AI Developments.title: Goa shares draft AI policy with stakeholders for inputs
Major AI Developments.summary: The state of Goa has shared a draft Artificial Intelligence (AI) policy with stakeholders to gather their inputs. This move aims to incorporate feedback and suggestions from various stakeholders before finalizing the policy. The draft policy is part of Goa's efforts to develop a comprehensive AI strategy.

Major AI Developments.title: Youth Congress protest at AI Summit tarnished India’s image: Pramod Sawant
Major AI Developments.summary: Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant criticized the Youth Congress for protesting at the AI Summit, calling it "political recklessness". He stated that their actions tarnished India's image, implying that the protest was detrimental to the country's reputation. The incident highlights a clash between political groups and the government's efforts to maintain a positive international image.

Major AI Developments.title: Goa strengthens AI commitment at India AI Impact Summit 2026
Major AI Developments.summary: Goa has reaffirmed its dedication to artificial intelligence at the India AI Impact Summit 2026. The summit highlights Goa's efforts to leverage AI for growth and development. Goa's participation demonstrates its commitment to embracing AI technology and innovation.

Major AI Developments.title: Govt depts, corporations identifying problems to resolve through AI
Major AI Developments.summary: Government departments and corporations are identifying problems to be resolved through artificial intelligence. They are working to utilize AI to address various issues, although specific details on the problems and AI solutions are not provided. The initiative aims to leverage AI technology to improve operations and efficiency.

Major AI Developments.title: AI traffic signals with smart cameras at 92 locations in Goa
Major AI Developments.summary: Goa has implemented AI-powered traffic signals with smart cameras at 92 locations. The intelligent system aims to improve traffic management and reduce congestion. The technology is expected to enhance road safety and efficiency in the region.

AI Start-Up News.title: Rekise Marine raises $9.7 Mn seed round led by Accel and NKSquared
AI Start-Up News.summary: Rekise Marine, a marine robotics startup, has raised $9.7 million in a seed funding round co-led by Accel and NKSquared. The funding round also saw participation from existing investors and new ones, including Industrial47 and several family offices. The proceeds will be used to develop the company's autonomous underwater vehicle, Jalkapi, and expand its engineering team.

AI Start-Up News.title: Bucketlistt raises pre-seed funding to scale experience tourism platform
AI Start-Up News.summary: Bucketlistt, a curated experiences marketplace, has raised Rs 1.07 crore in pre-seed funding at a valuation of Rs 10.07 crore from angel investors. The startup, founded in 2025, offers a platform for adventure, cultural, and spiritual experiences across India. Bucketlistt also operates OkGhumo, an ERP and CRM platform for experience operators to manage their businesses.
